body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## TESTING RULE (USER DIRECTIVE 2026-07-25)
**NEVER launch tests with the user's full modlist (isolated=false).** 900+ mods bury our diagnostics under 50+ unrelated startup/save-load errors. ALWAYS isolated=true with a minimal companionMods set (e.g. just Dubwise.DubsBadHygiene when a DBH test is needed) + build a fresh column via the dev action "As above\\AB: ensure sky + basement". The user's real column SAVE was made under the full list so it can't load isolated — test on a freshly generated column instead. Non-isolated only if the user explicitly asks.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (identity x/z; -2.5 y is altitude/sort only; 0.85 per-object shrink about each thing's own center).
- Selection survives column view switches AND pawn level-changes via stairs. All levels real maps; viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap. Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop.
- **See-below = RENDER overlay + per-interaction input hooks, NOT a general see-through** (RimWorld input is welded to Find.CurrentMap). Shared pattern (pass 33): ONE render-aware hit-test (`BelowSelection.SelectablesUnderMouse` / `TryBelowRightClickCell`) + ONE input-scope adapter (`ABCurrentMapSwap`). Selection (in-place, no jump) + orders (stair routing) keep bespoke semantics.
- **Designators OUT OF SCOPE (user decision pass 33):** "switch the view to that level to build/order" is acceptable.
- Logistics doctrine (pass 32/34): every ferry MONOTONE. Storage=vanilla+capacity clamp + **delivered-level retention (pass 34): once a ferry drops an item on a level, the STORAGE flows never lift it back off (demand still can) — kills the up/down loop, condition-based not timer.** Demand=shortfall+retention via PinnedByNativeNeed; in-flight ledger. Needs-bridge: postfix vanilla giver, re-run guard chain, probe linked levels, one-hop stairs job, per-pawn cooldowns. Work-migration hysteresis: post-arrival commitment cooldown, arrival-tick recharge, bumps only for level-linked maps.

## REMOVED FEATURES
SKYLIGHTS (round 7, postmortem pass 16). MOUNTAIN RIVERS + WATERFALLS (round 12, revisit dossier pass 22).

## VERIFIED (USER)
RMB cross-level · basement · Batch A · mech charge crash gone · bill supply + mech RMB · **PASS 33 see-below input parity — user: "everything else seems to work"**.

# PASS 34 — HARDENING WAVE (built green, NOT yet user-verified)
User batch (5 items):
1. **BUG1 storage-full haul loop KILLED.** Symptom: when a storage location is full, a pawn hauls an item up and down the stairs forever until it is forbidden or the storage is enlarged. Root cause: cross-level storage picks strictly-better storage with a scan-time absorb clamp, but the destination's free space is a scan-vs-arrival RACE (another hauler takes the slot mid-climb), so the item lands in worse storage and instantly chases the full better-storage again. `needAccurateResult` does NOT help (both modes validate via IsGoodStoreCell incl. reservations). Fix: **condition-based monotone retention in `CrossLevelDemand`** — `NoteTransferred` records `deliveredTo[itemId]={mapId,tick}`; `ExportAllowed` (STORAGE path only) returns false when `DeliveredHere(map,t)` (item still on the map a ferry delivered it to). So a delivered item is never storage-bounced back off its level; DEMAND pulls (`ExportAllowedForDemand`) are unaffected so consumers/relay still work. Storage-type AGNOSTIC (zone/shelf/modded container all hit the same gate). Timer only bounds the dict (60000t); the real gate is "still on delivered level", self-clears when the item leaves (consumed, demand-pulled, hand-moved). Covers single + bulk (PUAH/Hauler's Dream) — both route through TargetLevelFor->ExportAllowed.
2. **BUG2 GiddyUp raider dismount-spam fixed.** Symptom: mounted raiders spam "Dismount before using stairs or elevators." Root cause: `ABGiddyUpCompat.BlockForMount` posted the player message as a SIDE EFFECT, but the raider/neutral descend AI scans (`HostileDescend.ShouldDescendHostile/Friendly`, `ABNeutralExit.SweepMap`, the StairTransfer backstop) called it as a plain predicate every scan tick. Fix: those AI-scan sites now call the SILENT `IsMounted(p)`; `BlockForMount` (message) is kept only on genuine player-initiated stair jobs (JobDriver_UseStairs reservations, haul/bulk-haul, medical), now player-faction-gated + throttled (240t per rider via ABPawnCooldown).
3. **BUG3 mech-recharge subsystem hardened.** Symptom: Logistics subsystem hit an error and shut down over mechs not knowing where to recharge, esp. modded mechs. Root cause: the whole mech-charge postfix was one try/catch that tripped the ENTIRE Logistics kill switch if any charger/mech threw. Fix (`MechChargeAcrossLevels`): per-charger `CanPawnChargeCurrently` wrapped (skip + Log.WarningOnce naming the charger, keep scanning); `WantsCharge` reflection invoke wrapped (fall back to low-battery threshold); outer Disable + WVC-modes charge Disable pass `subject: pawn`.
4. **BUG4 Allow Tool urgent hauling honors the Haul+ work-type priority.** Symptom: "haul urgently does not persist when triggered via gizmo (Orders menu) or work-tab priority." Root cause: `AB_HaulUrgentlyAcrossLevels` is authored under the vanilla **Hauling** work type (safe default when Allow Tool absent), so Allow Tool's separate **HaulingUrgent** ("Haul+") numeric Work-tab priority never drove it and a pawn with Hauling off / Haul+ on did no cross-level urgent hauling. Fix (`ABAllowToolWorkType`, `[StaticConstructorOnStartup]`): when Allow Tool active, re-parent the giver's `workType` to HaulingUrgent and rebuild both work types' `workGiversByPriority` (priorityInType desc), before any pawn caches its giver order. Orders-menu designation path unchanged. General numeric-priority migration was already order-based (WorkGiversInOrderNormal) so it already respects Work Tab etc.
5. **QOL1 subsystem shutdowns name the culprit.** New `ABBlame`: `Describe(subject)` names a Thing/Def/Pawn + its source mod (`def.modContentPack.Name`); `BlameMod(exception)` walks the stack frames against a cached assembly->mod map (skips vanilla/us) to name the offending third-party mod. `ABGuard.Disable` gained an optional `subject` param; the log line, the in-game "subsystem down" Message, and the settings-panel tripped row now all name the likely cause. New Keyed: AB_SubsystemDownBecause, AB_GuardTrippedBecause. Wired into the mech-charge sites; other 100+ Disable calls keep working (subject defaults null -> falls back to stack attribution).

# PASS 33 — SEE-BELOW INPUT PARITY (USER-VERIFIED)
1. RMB building hit-test (`BelowSelection.TryBelowRightClickCell`, render-aware). 2. Elevation-lock GroundMap hardening. 3. Cross-level DRAG-BOX select. 4. Targeter WIDENING (action-only tool targeters). 5. Hover MOUSEOVER READOUT. Temp diagnostics stripped after verification.

## PASS 33 FOLLOW-UP (built green, NOT yet user-verified)
6. **Selection preserved across stairs/elevator/ladder** (`StairTransfer` captures selected transferring pawns pre-DeSpawn, re-adds in place via `BelowSelection.RestoreSelected`).

## INTERACTION AUDIT (vanilla mouse/UI x see-below) — pass 33
- Select single/double/shift + drag-box + bracket + inspect/gizmos ✅; selection kept across stairs ✅(pending verify). Info: mouseover readout ✅(hover); always-on floating labels ❌ not built. RMB orders ✅. Targeters incl action-only ✅. Designators ❌ OUT OF SCOPE. Camera ✅.

## OPTIONAL future (proposed, not committed)
Unify hit-test into one BelowInput.Resolve(). Always-on floating below-thing labels. Group camera-follow up/down stairs.

# VANILLA PARITY SCAFFOLD (P0-P3 done passes 27-30; P4 verify-only backlog stands). COMPAT BUILT pass 31: WVC Work Modes · Stratum · Sand & Snow Coverage.

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
AB: ensure sky+basement · basement diagnostic · light diagnostic · RMB diagnostic · below-view diagnostic.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE (run ISOLATED + dev-built column)
**PASS 34 (TOP), each needs its companion:**
- BUG1: fill a stockpile/shelf full on level A, drop a haulable on level B whose only better storage is the full one -> pawn must NOT ride it up/down forever; it settles where delivered. Also PUAH bulk variant.
- BUG2 (companion GiddyUp): trigger a mounted raid -> NO "dismount" spam. Player mounted colonist ordered onto stairs still gets ONE throttled message.
- BUG3 (Biotech + modded mechs if any): mech on a level with no charger -> routes to a linked charger, and a throwing modded charger/mech does NOT trip Logistics (check log for the named WarningOnce).
- BUG4 (companion UnlimitedHugs.AllowTool): set Haul+ priority in Work tab (Hauling OFF), designate Haul Urgently across levels -> pawn hauls it across. Also Orders-menu path.
- QOL1: force any subsystem error -> in-game message + log + settings row name the item/mod.
Pass-33 follow-up: selection kept across stairway. Pass-32 queue still pending: ferry round-2, pass-31 compat session, below lighting, animal flow, BAM/Batch B/C, perf/CE-absent/translation/soak/publishing, P4 sweep.

## FEATURE LEDGER
RMB 1:1 (VERIFIED incl. pass-33 building hit-test) · basement (VERIFIED) · haul/ferry (p32 monotone + **p34 delivered-level retention**) · below lighting · animal flows · mech charge (VERIFIED + **p34 hardened**) · work-migration commitment (p32) · elevation lock (VERIFIED) · drag-box select (VERIFIED) · targeter widening (VERIFIED) · hover readout (VERIFIED) · selection-across-stairs (p33 follow-up, pending) · **GiddyUp dismount no-spam (p34, pending)** · **Allow Tool Haul+ work-type parity (p34, pending)** · **subsystem-failure culprit naming (p34, pending)** · P0-P3 parity · pass-31 compat. REMOVED: skylights, mountain rivers. OUT OF SCOPE: cross-level designators.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE · Biomes! Caverns · Alpha Biomes · BM+MO · Odyssey+VLE · Misc. Robots/++ · Hauler's Dream+PUAH · Allow Tool (p34 Haul+ work-type parity) · Ancient urban ruins · CE · Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up (p34 no dismount-spam)/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF · Trader Airships, Hospitality · BAM · PO/Dubs Analyzer/TPT · WVC Work Modes · Stratum · Sand & Snow Coverage · INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta · UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Status
2026-07-25 (34th pass): Hardening wave, all built green (0 warn/0 err), NOT yet user-verified. Fixed the 5-item user batch: (1) storage-full up/down haul loop via monotone delivered-level retention in CrossLevelDemand; (2) GiddyUp mounted-raider dismount-message spam (AI scans use silent IsMounted; player message throttled + faction-gated); (3) mech-recharge Logistics subsystem hardened against modded mechs/chargers (granular try/catch, WarningOnce, no whole-subsystem trip); (4) Allow Tool urgent hauling now attaches to the HaulingUrgent (Haul+) work type so its numeric Work-tab priority drives cross-level urgent hauls; (5) subsystem shutdowns now name the culprit item/mod/thing (ABBlame) in log, in-game message, and settings panel. Testing per directive is ISOLATED + dev-built column, each item with its own companion mod.
